scope_note: Non-contributory benefit eligibility (UC, Child Benefit, Pension Credit, HB and others) for EEA migrants, a household entitlement rule.

expressibility_note: The affected children are outside the FRS household population.
measure: Child Benefit and Child Tax Credits: end exporting for children outside the UK from January 2021
missing_machinery: No children resident abroad in the household data and no exportability rule.
scope_note: Child Benefit and CTC eligibility for children living outside the UK, a household entitlement rule.

expressibility_note: The threshold has nothing to act on.
measure: Universal Credit: delay surplus earnings threshold reduction by one year
missing_machinery: No surplus earnings rule: UC is computed on annual income with no monthly assessment periods or carry-forward of surplus earnings.
scope_note: UC surplus earnings rule, a household entitlement rule.

expressibility_note: The description gives no detail of the support, and the transition is not modelled.
measure: Universal Credit: additional support for claimants transferring to pension credit
missing_machinery: No UC-to-Pension-Credit transition or run-on mechanics; UC and Pension Credit are evaluated independently each year.
scope_note: Support for UC claimants moving to Pension Credit, a household entitlement rule.

measure: Universal Credit: changes to severe disability premium regulations
missing_machinery: No UC transitional SDP element and no migration-history tracking. severe_disability_premium exists only for legacy benefits.
scope_note: Severe disability premium regulations for claimants moving to UC (transitional SDP payments), a household entitlement rule.

expressibility_note: A delay to the rollout cannot be set.
measure: Universal credit: further delays
missing_machinery: No UC rollout or managed-migration machinery: gov.dwp.universal_credit.rollout_rate exists, but no formula reads it, and UC versus legacy comes from the dataset (would_claim_uc, reported receipt).
scope_note: Timetable for moving legacy claimants to UC, which decides the household benefit received.

expressibility_note: A rollout delay cannot be set.
